text: Maranem is a draenei located at the Altar of Sha'tar in Shadowmoon Valley.
Mar'gok's Overwatch is a Gorian outpost in southeastern named after Imperator Mar'gok. There, Grand Magister Reglakk performs research on the magic-resistant Breaker ogres.

Mara Swiftmane is a tauren druid in Cat Form found inside a cave in Pinerock Basin in Highmountain, where three Amateur Hunters — Dargok Thunderuin, Ryael Dawndrifter and "Sure-Shot" Arnie — have cornered her in the belief that she is a lion whose severed head will allow them entry into Trueshot Lodge. After the hunters have been killed, Mara transforms back into her tauren form, thanks the adventurer who saved her life and directs them to the Battered Chest behind her before running out of the cave and despawning.

Manti'vess was a great colony established by an enclave of aqir in the southern parts of Ancient Kalimdor during the later stages of the war between them and the trolls, roughly 16,000 years BDP. Under the roots of the great kypari trees, these aqir, known thereafter as mantid, established a new empire. They saw no purpose in continuing a battle they knew they were not strong enough to win. They believed that the best way to serve the Old Gods, whom they still fervently worshipped, was to conserve and refine the mantid's strength rather than expending it. While a revered empress ruled over the mantid's day-to-day activities, a council known as the Klaxxi controlled the insectoids' destiny. R
Maokka is a tortollan located at the Jeweled Coast in Stormsong Valley, seen bathing a Sandbill Piper. He later appeared on Mechagon Island.
Mantid Relics are found at the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes.
Manish Megafault is a goblin located in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island.
Mar'kowa, the Mindpiercer drops from Drest'agath in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Many-Teeth is a gorloc who can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Manifesting Power is a potential daily quest available after activating the Anima Conductor to the Eternal Forge.
The Manifesto of Madness drops from N'Zoth the Corruptor in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Many-Braids the Elder is a musken located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Many-Fangs is a saurok located in Island Expeditions.
__NOTOC__ Manipulator Zalisar is an aranakk located in the Sightless Hold in Maldraxxus. He had briefly taken control of the remnants of the House of Eyes following the fall of the House.
Many, Many Things is awarded to players who earn every The Box of Many Things perk in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. It rewards the Mord'al Eveningstar battle pet.
Mantle of Waning Radiance drops from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.

Manual: The Path of Defense was a quest reward from Vejrek (quest). It would teach Defensive Stance, Taunt (warrior ability) and Sunder Armor. The spells it taught are now learned directly through the quest.

Marda Weller is the co-owner of Weller's Arsenal with her (assumed) husband Gunther Weller. She is a weapons vendor and can be found in their shop near the Stormwind auction house, just off the main square in the trade district of Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Maria Lumere is a human alchemy vendor located in the Alchemy Needs shop in the far eastern section of the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City.
Mark of the Dragon Lord is a Level 55 quality Ring that improves Stamina. It has an on-use ability that temporarily creates a protective shield around the caster and greatly increases Versatility.

__NOTOC__ Margol the Rager is a thunder lizard found in the Searing Gorge. Margol wanders in and out of his cave in the hills east of the Tanner Camp, in the southeastern part of the land. Legend has it that he ate Burrian Coalpart's brother Barnabas. Mountaineer Pebblebitty's axe head is stuck in Margol's horn.

Marin Noggenfogger is the creator of the famous Noggenfogger Elixir and, ever since the Cataclysm, the baron of the goblin city of Gadgetzan in Tanaris. He is married to Sprinkle, whom he previously considered a mere friend. He is also a leader of the Steamwheedle Cartel. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, he joined the Uncrowned to give his expertise in poisons and alchemy.

March of the Scourge is Chapter Five of the Scourge of Lordaeron campaign. It involves the player defending their base from a large undead assault. There is also a side quest in which the player is given the option to go out and destroy a caravan of plagued grain before it infects all the outer villages.

Mark of Death is a debuff that is applied to players who die while engaged with the Doomwalker. This is to prevent graveyard zerging, and acts like other world boss knockout debuffs by lasting for 15 minutes. The debuff will cause you to instantly die if you get too close to Doomwalker. However, you will not take any durability loss to your armor.
Margaux Parchley is a Forsaken inscription trainer found in the Apothecarium section of the Undercity.

The Mark of Kathra'natir is a powerful corrupting curse. Once the curse is cast, the subject becomes the host of the dreadlord Kathra'natir. Vendellin Soulfire cast this spell on Valeera Sanguinar during her journey to Stormwind with Varian Wrynn, Broll Bearmantle and Thargas Anvilmar. Aegwynn helped her deal with the curse and Meryl Winterstorm later challenged the dreadlord to possess him instead it.
__NOTOC__ Marius Tanolaar is a night elf located at the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara. He appears after looting the Weapons Cabinet.
Mare Wildrunner is the Horde far seer in Ashran, who allowed players who had completed Survey Ashran (Horde) to channel a Far Sight-like spell to view each of the island's secondary areas.
The following NPCs can be found in Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Marina Sentries are nightborne found in the city of Suramar.
Margul is a drogbar innkeeper located in the Stonedark Grotto in Highmountain.

Mariner's Row is a residential area in Boralus. It is located along the southeastern wall that leads from Crosswind Commons to Eastpoint Station. During Faction Assaults, the area is bombarded by the Horde, and its gate is breached, allowing the forces to enter the city.

Mariner's Strand is an island in Stormsong Valley dedicated to shipbuilding. Scripps Lumber Co., Layson & Sons Rigging, and The Brineworks all funnel parts to the Addington Shipyards. The area has been taken over by corrupted tidesages and the Stormsong militia. A large graveyard called Seafarer's Rest can be found here as well, along with a hill with Galestorm on it. Larger battleships are built at Port Fogtide across the water, connected to this strand by the bridge at Tidecross.
The Mark of the Bleeding Hollow is a fel spire found in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal. Destroying it releases Teron'gor.
The Marine Grotto is a cave located in Island Expeditions. It is accessed through the Swirling Postern. Lord Abyssian can be found there.
The Mark of Defiant Survival is a quest reward from Overwhelming Power (quest).
This article lists micro dungeon maps for micro dungeons appearing on Mardum, the Shattered Abyss.
Marine Cadets are humans located in Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City.
Margrave Stradama is the last boss of Plaguefall. She was the leader of the House of Plagues before their seat was destroyed.
Marastar is a faerie located at Glitterfall Basin in Ardenweald. She was present during The Battle of Ardenweald.

The Mark of Boistrous Duty is looted from the Corrupted Chest at the end of the Vision of Stormwind or the Vision of Orgrimmar. It can only be looted by classes with a tank specialization. Infusing the item at the Heart Forge will grant Rank 1 of the Strength of the Warden Essence and leave behind a Tarnished Mark.
Mark of Conk-quest is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mark of Masochism is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Marion Velox is a Maldraxxi skeleton who briefly apears in Maldraxxus during Enemy at the Door.
__NOTOC__ Mariner Keenstar is a member of the crew of the Elune's Blessing, the boat that runs between Teldrassil and Valaar's Berth in the Azuremyst Isle.
__NOTOC__ Mariner Farsight is a member of The Moonspray, the boat that runs between Auberdine and Rut'theran Village. She, with the help of the wisp, watches the seas for any lost souls.
]] :"May Cenarius smile upon you." :— Archdruid Hamuul Runetotem Mark of the Wild is a druid ability that buffs party members' Versatility.

Marshal Marris is a human quest giver located near the bridge in Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains. He is concerned about the number of orcs in the area and wants them and their leader, Tharil'zun, killed. Since the Cataclysm, he is seen heavily drinking.

Martek the Exiled is an orc quest giver located in a small camp within the Scar of the Worldbreaker, along with Lucien Tosselwrench and Theldurin the Lost, in the Badlands. Prior to the Cataclysm, he was located in a small camp which was destroyed in the Valley of Fangs. It is unknown what happened to his former companions, Rigglefuzz and Jazzrik. During Thousand Boat Bash, he is seen in Mirage Abyss in Thousand Needles along with Theldurin and Lucien.

Marshal Bluewall is a dwarf quest giver located at the Hive'Zora Alliance camp in Silithus. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, as several bodies of the Ironforge Brigade were found in the destroyed Silithus, it is unclear if Bluewall managed to escape or perished as well.
__NOTOC__ Marsilla Dawnstar is a blood elf located near the fountain of Falconwing Square in Eversong Woods.
Marksman Regiment's Cooking Pot is located in Shattrath City.

Marla Fowler can be found in the War Quarter of Undercity. Alongside Robert Gossom, Richard Van Brunt, Chloe Curthas, Riley Walker and Andrew Hartwell she's cheering for Edward and Tyler, who are engaged in a fight.

Marn Thunderhorn is a Tauren Chieftain who compiled a guide on Warcraft information, known as Marn Thunderhorn's Warcraft III Strategy Guide. His guide included everything from the Third War, military strategy and comprehensive taxonomy of the Warcraft Universe's inhabitants. He welcomed and let the pitiful humans see his guide.

Marshal McCree is a human quest giver located in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He is in charge of the Stormwind Guard in and around the Eastvale Logging Camp. He can be found in the center of the camp; near the flightmaster Goss the Swift.
Marshal Paltrow is a human in command at the Northwatch forward camp in Windshear Valley of Stonetalon Mountains.
Marsa Keybrand was a human Isle of Conquest battlemaster located in Shattrath's Lower City during the Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest.
Marog was an orc Isle of Conquest battlemaster located in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest.
Marshtide Sentries can be found guarding the Alliance outpost of Marshtide Watch in Swamp of Sorrows. A powerful top-level version appears if Horde approach the settlement.
__NOTOC__ Marksman Bova is a draenei located at the Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.
Marksman Twinrise is a blood elf located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Marla is a worgen located in the Trader's Hall in Trade District in Stormwind City. During the Auction House Dance Party event, Marla hijacks the auction house.

Mark of the Sentinel is a druid glyph that changes the druid's flying Travel Form into an owl. Night elves in sentinel form are blue and gold; worgen are purple; trolls are pale gray; and tauren are brown. This glyph can only be applied if the druid is trained up to at least Artisan Riding.

Marked Trees are trees surrounded by wisps in the Twilight Vale in Darkshore. They were felled by the Horde adventurer flying a Goblin Hellion during the War of the Thorns in order to weaken Malfurion's wisp wall.
Marshstomper Oracle's Loop drops from Flotsam in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ Marshal Layre is a worgen located at Brackish Coast in Drustvar. She only appears when the world quest Dogged Tenacity is active, during which she is initially un-attackable until the Gilnean camp has been adequately assaulted. She is guarded by Gilnean Officers.
The Mark of the Shattered Hand is found in the Soul Engine below the in Tanaan Jungle during the Assault on the Dark Portal.
Marksman Rakatu is a Highmountain tauren located in Arathi Basin for Alliance players.
Marrowmaw, Son of Bonefang, is a flayedwing who spawns on the Shattered Span in Bastion during The Final Countdown. __NOTOC__
Mark of the Ogre is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Marrow Scooper is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mark of the Master Assassin is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Master Assassin's Mark.

Marshal Patterson is a human quest giver located in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. He is in charge of the Stormwind Guard in and around the Eastvale Logging Camp. He can be found in the center of the camp; near the flightmaster Goss the Swift.
Marshal's Mooncloth Belt is sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Mooncloth Cuffs are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 1 Mark of Honor.
Marshal's Mooncloth Slippers are sold by Kezzik the Striker in the Netherstorm for 2 Mark of Honor.
Mark of the Sable Dreamtalon drops from Ristar, the Rabid in a cave in the Viridescent Thicket in the Emerald Dream.

Master Apothecary Faranell is a Forsaken, the Master of the Royal Apothecary Society, and a member of the Desolate Council. He is a doctor or has at least some type of a doctorate, and enjoyed experimenting with different brews and tinctures, trying this or that to cure something or improve one's life. Faranell and his alchemist minions work to brew their newest toxins, as well as creating more powerful abominations to serve the Forsaken. As the Master of the Apothecarium, he oversees the most ambitious of their alchemical attempts. Following the Forsaken reclaiming the Ruins of Lordaeron he, alongside other prominent Forsaken, created a new Desolate Council to serve as the governing body of
Mary Edras is a Forsaken first aid trainer located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.

Martie Jainrose is a human quest giver located in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. She is the local herbalist, and it is implied that she fancies Guard Parker. She is also annoyed that the boar Bellygrub has been trampling her garden as of late.

Master Elemental Shaper Krixix is an elite goblin found in Blackwing Lair within Blackrock Mountain. He is the former apprentice of a high elf, Earthcaller Franzahl. Krixix spent his life trying to contact the Old Gods. A decade ago, as both master and apprentice were studying the fissures of Darkwhisper Gorge, an earth elemental sprung out of the ground and took Krixix away.
The Masonary is located beneath the central rock of Blackrock Mountain, beyond the Grinding Quarry, just before the entrance to Blackrock Depths.
Master Kang is an orc found near Ravenholdt Manor in the Alterac Mountains. He is training Ravenholdt Sentries.

__NOTOC__ Mass Dispel is a priest class talent that dispels magic within a 15 yard radius of the targeted area, dispelling all harmful debuffs from friendly targets and 1 beneficial buff from enemy targets, affecting up to 5 friendly and 5 enemy targets.

__NOTOC__ Master Kelerun Bloodmourn is a blood elf quest giver located in Eversong Woods between Sunstrider Isle and the Ruins of Silvermoon. He was the overseer of the Second Trial that young Blood Knights had to go through in the pavilion nearby. Following the death of Tirion Fordring, he joined the Silver Hand and is located in the Sanctum of Light. Occasionally, he can be seen healing himself and speaking with Eligor Dawnbringer. Following the split of the Order during the Fourth War, he is no longer a member of the Silver Hand.
Master Cannoneer Boots are a pair of Level 42 quality Plate Boots that improve Strength, Stamina and Critical Strike.

Many enchanters are students of magic. Yet, not all enchanters are spellcasters. The act of destruction releases energy and sometimes a reckless warrior or an inquisitive tinker may stumble upon the means to absorb this energy and channel it into creation. They are called martial enchanters.

Mason Goldgild was originally found in the Canals of Stormwind City. when Baros Alexston hired the Royal Stonecutter's Guild, Goldgild was sent. She planned to take down the entire wall in one blast, which allowed Foreman Wick to build the new gatehouse and road leading to Stormwind Harbor. The construction crew includes: * Construction Workers * Dwarven Construction Workers * Underwater Construction Workers
Marvin Wobblesprocket is a gnome flight master located at River's Heart in Sholazar Basin. He is married to the human Tamara Wobblesprocket.

Masha Cliffwalker is the wife of High Chieftain Cliffwalker and mother to their son Orthus. During the questline in Stonetalon Mountains, she along with her husband and son are trying to protect Thal'darah Grove from Overlord Krom'gar's and General Grebo's false accusations. When it turns out that Grebo killed their son, the infuriated Chieftain, Masha, and the Horde adventurer kill the general. In return, Krom'gar travels to Cliffwalker Post and kills Masha and burns the entire camp.

Marus is a rare mob worgen found patrolling around the Rotting Orchard and a small hidden area containing his cave and a few Nightbane Shadow Weavers. He sleeps in the cave between patrols. With the death of Gutspill by adventurers prior to the Shattering, Marus has become the new pack leader of the Nightbane pack.
__NOTOC__ Master Assassin Kel'istra is a blood elf located in the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains. She is a master assassin that is directing the attacks of other Horde assassins in the mine.
Master Angler Marina is a representative of the Anglers sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars to recruit Alliance. She can be found on the lower level of the Summer Terrace.
__NOTOC__ Master Angler Karu is a representative of the Anglers sent to the Shrine of Two Moons to recruit Horde. He can be found on the lower level of the Golden Terrace.

Master Hight is the Grand Master of the Peak of Serenity in Pandaria's Kun-Lai Summit. Monks who use Zen Pilgrimage to travel to the Peak will often check in with him as they progress through their training, and he will administer their final test to them personally. In Legion, Hight was killed while aiding a monk adventurer in disabling a demonic portal during the Burning Legion's assault on the Peak of Serenity. The survivors escaped to the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle, with the adventurer becoming the new Grand Master in Hight's stead. During A Monk's Focus, the Visage of Master Hight briefly appears when a monk adventurer meditates in the Darkmaul Plains on Exile's Reach, t
Maruul is a draenei marksman found at Icepine Point in Highmountain. He appears to be involved in a rivalry with Emily Wells.
Master Arcanists are human and gnome mages located in Stormwind Embassy in Stormwind City, speaking with a Riftwarden Acolyte.
Maryann is a chicken found in Stormwind City outside the house of Kelly Aguilar.
The Master Dinomancer's Tunic drops from Mor'fani the Exile in a ruined tower on a small unnamed island off the southern coast of Vol'dun.
Marvelous Martini is located in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island. While not working on the cats, Martini likes to paint paintings.
Massive Leystone Deposit is a mining vein found in Highmountain.

Marvin was a stable groom in service to House Wrynn during Anduin's childhood. He was hardly older than Anduin. When King Varian brought the prince to the stables to give him his first pony, Anduin asked why horses were measured in hands. Varian admitted he didn't know and gruffly asked Marvin if he knew, but neither he nor anyone else in the stables did. When Anduin related the story to Mathias Shaw, Shaw got a distant expression on his face and claimed that he didn't know the stable boy. Anduin felt that Shaw was lying and that Marvin had probably died at some point.
The Mask of Power is an enchanted tiki located in Krazzlefrazz Outpost in Drustvar during Faction Assaults. It is part of the Tiki Army.
Master Clerk Salorn is a sylvar located at Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. He sells various rewards related to events at the amphitheater.
Mask of the Winged Dominator is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mask of Withering is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Massive Seaforium Charges were used to destroy the gates in the Strand of the Ancients.

The Maruukai Ancestors are two centaur spirits that briefly appear after the Spiced Game Meat is placed on an offering table during Honoring Our Ancestors in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. They descend from the sky to the table, offer a salute, and then fade from view again.

__NOTOC__ Maruuk, renowned as Maruuk Thousandbones, was the namesake and one of the two founders of the Maruuk centaur. After making a name for himself battling the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients, he and his wife, Teera, led the centaur to settle on the Ohn'ahran Plains of the Dragon Isles. He was the centaur's greatest warrior and wielded the spear :Batubar the Relentless, which is said to have been infused with power by Ohn'ahra.
Massive Leystone Ore is mined from Massive Leystone Deposits in Highmountain.

:Are you looking for statistics? See Warcraft III units. The Master of Pain was a powerful doomguard champion who lived in the red desert of Outland under the command of Magtheridon. He guarded treasure in Magtheridon's Black Temple and acted as his dark lieutenant. He was defeated when a force of blood elves and Broken under the command of Kael'thas Sunstrider and Akama (themselves serving Illidan Stormrage) assaulted the Temple. Upon his and the Mistress of Torment's fall, the gates to the Throne Chamber opened. Like other members of the Burning Legion, he would eventually coalesce back into his physical form in the Nether.
Master Sergeant Maclure was a human quest giver located in the Trade District in Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Master Sergeant Moonshadow was a night elf quest giver located in the Temple Gardens in Darnassus.

Mastery is a passive mechanic specific to each specialization from level 10 that can be increased with stats. Mastery effects are found in the character sheet, in addition to the Spellbook under each specialization tab. Each Mastery offers specific benefits which can vary but generally fall into one of three categories: increasing the effectiveness of specific abilities or types of damage dealt; becoming more effective when certain conditions are met; or providing bonus effects including DoTs, HoTs, free attacks, or free spellcasts. All mastery benefits are measured in percentages, whether in terms of a numerical improvement, the size of an effectiveness boost or bonus effect, or a proc chan
Mato is a food and drink vendor in The Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within the mage city of Dalaran.

__NOTOC__ Master Sergeant Pietro Zaren is an officer in the 7th Legion. He and his submariners slaughtered Captain Rutsak's men at Rutsak's Guard, sparing him so he would witness their strength. Forward Commander Onslaught wants him killed.

Mathel Rustwrench is a gnome located in Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh. He owns and services a flying machine that is used for the quest Get to the Airfield. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Matron Ismara is a blood elf member of the Scryers and a priest trainer located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

Mastery: Divine Bulwark is the Protection paladin Mastery, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It increases the chance to block incoming attacks, and reduces damage taken while standing inside Consecration. It also increases attack power.

Master engineer goggles are a variety of head-worn items created by Engineers with master-level engineering skill or greater. Each class is offered training to create only a select variety of these, usually limited to a single type. Schematics for a second set of these items are found as drops in Sunwell Plateau. All versions of master engineer goggles require Primal Nether. The trained varieties require one, the sunwell variety require 4. Primal Nether is dropped by the final bosses in Burning Crusade Heroic mode dungeons, but is not soulbound, and so may be found on the auction house or from higher level/older characters. The high component costs, and the ready availability of items from W
Mastery: Elusive Brawler is the Mastery for Brewmaster monks, improved by the mastery secondary stat, learned at Level 10. This ability increases dodge based on melee attacks the monk receives.
Master Zhang is a pandaren found in the middle of a staring contest with Kiang Redwhisker at the Emperor's Step at the Shrine of Seven Stars.

__NOTOC__ Master Thal'darah is a night elf quest giver located at the Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains. Worried for the druids of Thal'darah Grove, he sends an Alliance agent to rescue the Helpless Young Druids on his hippogryph. Thal'darah has a deep hatred for the Horde, and this burden only increased with the destruction of the grove.

__NOTOC__ Master Nguyen is one of the five sorcerers that are found around Pandaria. According to Master Nguyen, the sorcerers have been wandering since the days of Lei Shen, passing the secrets of their order from generation to generation. He will not tell you what the secrets are and he does not know where the other sorcerers are as he no longer remembers. He says that they may very well be dead or may have been replaced by their pupils. Also, he has the buff and has an air of electricity around him at all times.

Mastery: Icicles is the Frost mage mastery effect, improved by the mastery secondary stat. It allows the mage to generate and store Icicles by casting Frostbolt or Flurry, and unleash them with Ice Lance. It also increases damage dealt by Frozen Orb (mage ability).

Mastery: Primal Tenacity is the Guardian druid Mastery, gained at level 80. Its effect is increased by the mastery secondary stat. Its calculation uses the damage before any other absorbs you have and before Tooth and Claw's effects.
Matron Hagatha is a harpy located within a mountain cave in Suramar.

Matilda Skoptidottir is a senior Valarjar Val'kyr located in Skyhold within the Halls of Valor. During the campaign on the Broken Isles, she was responsible for dispensing Horns of War to the Battlelord. With this empowered item, Odyn's val'kyr could be unleashed on specific targets with great effect. Matilda can be found just off the Arena of Glory in Skyhold's east wing.
Master of Disaster is a Destruction warlock artifact trait. It is linked to the Demonic Durability, Devourer of Life, and Flames of the Pit traits.

Mastercraft is a passive racial ability for all mechagnomes, causing you to function as an anvil, a Cooking Fire and a forge. Profession tools are also rendered obsolete to you, except for the bonuses they may provide.
Mathias may refer to: *Mathias Shaw, leader of SI:7 **Overlord Mathias Shaw, alternate self **Master Mathias Shaw (Through the Dark Portal) *Mathias Zunn, Ashran mob *Mathias, Flynn Fairwind's parrot
Mastery: Grace is Discipline priest mastery ability that increases the healing and absorption effects of targets affected by Atonement.
__NOTOC__ Matriarch Nas'naya is a taunka located in Island Expeditions.

Mastercraft Gravewing is a gravewing flying mount rewarded from the Venthyr-only quest Gravewing Crystal. The quest is started by the Gravewing Crystal (item), which rarely drops from the Stygian Stonecrusher vignette at the Vault of Secrets in southern Korthia.
Mastery: Giantkiller is the Mastery for Devastation evokers, improved by the mastery secondary stat.

Matchmaker Osila is a centaur of Clan Nokhud located on the eastern edge of the Field of Ferocity in the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is, apparently, responsible for matching pairs of young centaur, but has a much more flippant view of marriage traditions than Elder Odgerel. __NOTOC__
Matthew Hooper is a human fishing trainer located on the Lakeshire docks in the Redridge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ The Mature Blue Dragon Sinew is the tendon of dragonkin from the blue dragonflight. It could be taken from Azuregos in Azshara and dragonkin in Winterspring.
Mattie Alred is a Forsaken found walking around with Edrick Killian in the Undercity. They travel through the War Quarter and along the innermost ring.

The Maw of Lycanthoth is a cave, containing Lycanthoth's Altar, found south of the Shrine of Goldrinn in Mount Hyjal. Lycanthoth must be summoned and destroyed so that Goldrinn can return to the world.

The Maw of Go'rath is the gaping maw of Go'rath found in the Dragon Soul where Warlord Zon'ozz awaits anyone brave enough to face him and his faceless one underlings within. The maw also appears during Island Expeditions. General Shuul'aqar is found here.
Matron Vi Vinh is the innkeeper in the Shrine of Seven Stars, the Alliance hub in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. A version of her appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Maven Zara is holding the portal to Stormwind City open in the cellar of Tol Barad when the Alliance have ownership.

Mavis Harms is one of three Alliance champions found at Lion's Landing in eastern Krasarang Wilds. She is only attackable by Horde players, but there are equivalent Horde champions. Mavis spawns by the northernmost dock on the pier of Lion's Landing. Mavis hits hard and fast for a world mob and has several lethal abilities. Bringing friends is advised although she is possible to kill solo.
__NOTOC__ Mawat'aki is an ice elemental located at the Snowblind Cliffs in Highmountain.
Matthew's House of Magic is a shop located in the first half of the backstreets of Old Stratholme.

The Maw, Wasteland of the Damned, is one of the realms of the Shadowlands. This horrific place houses the most vile and irredeemable souls in existence. Ruled by the enigmatic Jailer, the Maw inspires nightmares and legends even among the denizens of the Shadowlands. No one has ever escaped this vile place, and any foolish enough to venture here are never heard from again. At its center lies Torghast, a cursed otherworldly prison where the most wicked souls in the universe are locked away. In recent years, the machinery of Death has been broken, and all souls who enter the Shadowlands are now condemned to torment in the Maw, no matter their deeds in life. This has caused the Maw to begin gro
The Maw of Gor'ma is the gaping maw of Gor'ma located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. The Spawning Pit and the Warren of Decay are found within.
In the Maw, necromancers (occasionally referred to as Maw magi) are humanoids employed by the Mawsworn army. The Jailer all too well knows there is great power in the dark art of necromancy.
__NOTOC__ The Mawsworn Patrol Map drops from mobs in the Maw with higher chance from more powerful enemies.

__NOTOC__ Matthien Radiantgaze is a void elf located in the Tipsy Tinkerer in Rustbolt on Mechagon Island. Drinking a beverage, he is sitting back to the Rustbolt Kegerator, while his companion Nyx is sleeping next to him. He had come to Mechagon seeking a robot for his son, Firion.
Maws of Drest'agath are tentacles located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.

__NOTOC__ The Mawsworn Runemasters were two Mawsworn kyrian located at Desmotaeron in the Maw. They had come to drain Ve'brax of his essences. By the time they arrived, Runemaster Mavrok had been killed by the Maw Walker, and the broker was able to defend himself properly, as the magics keeping him trapped had faded. Other, shade-like runemasters appear at the Altar of Domination during the puzzle to obtain Crumbling Stele.
Maw-Darkened Slippers is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mawrat Scent Gland is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mawrats on Ice is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Maw Infernous is a powerful charred behemoth summoned by Kel'Thuzad in the House of Rituals in Maldraxxus during The Medallion of Dominion / The Third Fall of Kel'Thuzad. Upon emerging, it starts instantly incinerating the Necrolord forces, and players have to work with General Draven to kill it. __NOTOC__
Mawsworn Realmbreakers are kyrian located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald. They are seen flying high above the battlefield.
The Mawsworn Destroyer is a Mawsworn construct located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Mawsworn Ravagers are dead Maw guards located throughout Oribos during Report to Oribos. Their corpses litter the ground throughout large parts of the city.
Maw Rattle is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Rattle of the Maw.
Mawdapted Raptora is a raptora flying mount created with Protoform Synthesis; taught by Schematic: Mawdapted Raptora.

The Mechanical Yeti is a guardian pet obtained from the quest Are We There, Yeti? (quest) in Everlook. It has three charges and packs a powerful punch. If you don't need a guardian, you may prefer the Tranquil Mechanical Yeti. It is worth noting that activating in a neutral town (such as Everlook) will result in the guards attacking you.

In World of Warcraft, a mechanic can mean a couple of things: # Short for "Game Mechanic". A way that a computer game simulates virtual world conditions, such as combat, consciousness, health, magic and movement. # A mode of interaction for your character in game. See Mechanic as Mode below. # NPCs who are mechanics.

Mechanized Guardians are level 28 elite robotic gnomes mounted on mechanostriders that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance. These are both standard mobs, and mobs summoned by a Mobile Alert System that is not suppressed (destroyed) in time.

The Mechanar is the first wing of the Tempest Keep instance. It serves as a base for Pathaleon the Calculator and also generates manacells, which contain an incredible amount of power. It once belonged to the Naaru. The area is filled with Mo'args as well as Bloodwarder and Sunseekers blood elves. This is the purple crystal building south of the main palace. At level 80, the instance is easily soloable on normal mode, while heroic mode is a challenge and requires high-level gear for most classes. At level 85, the instance becomes an easy gold run even in heroic mode.

Meathook is an abomination and the first boss of the Culling of Stratholme, a wing of the Caverns of Time. He demands the party play with him. In Warcraft III: Reforged, he was added into The Culling, hiding within one of Stratholme's houses and ambushing Arthas's forces once the house is destroyed.

Mayor Bramblestaff is a pandaren quest giver located at Binan Village in Kun-Lai Summit. He is the leader of the village and is good friends with Lorewalker Cho. Adventurers find him fending off a Yaungol and asks them to take out their leader by luring him out. After the battle, Bramblestaff guides them to their faction leaders, who are currently recovering at the village. He is also the organiser of the Brewmoon Festival.

, which Captain Su-Dao claims looks "just like" Mazu.]] Mazu is a beautiful goddess of the sea with power over waters and winds. She has the head of a night elf and slender arms, and wears shells around her neck and strings of pearls on her hips. She supposedly saved Captain "Soggy" Su-Dao from a violent storm in his youth by sending Dog to rescue him.

Mecha-Bruce is one of the special Rank 6 Challenge Card encounters in the Brawler's Guild. To fight him, players must use Challenge Card: Mecha-Bruce, purchased from the card trader in the arena. To unlock the ability to purchase the challenge card, players must first purchase Challenge Card: Bruce from the same card trader and beat Bruce once again. A quest-starting item will automatically be awarded upon Bruce's second death.
__NOTOC__ Mayruna Moonwing is a night elf located at the Irongrove Retreat in Suramar.

The Mechanical Engineers' Guild of Azeroth, or MEGA, is an organization of engineers. In addition to building mechanical contraptions like speedboats, MEGA sponsors races at Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge in Thousand Needles and races like it all over Azeroth. Another event takes place in the Charred Vale in Stonetalon Mountains. Engineers that want to participate in the races must be members in good standing of MEGA to register. Charnas is MEGA's official artist.

Mechagnomes (aka Mechagon mechagnome, and referred to by Blizzard as junker gnomes but not in-game) are a race of partially mechanical to fully mechanical gnomes that inhabit the island of Mechagon and are descended from the regular gnomes of Gnomeregan. They span a variety of different types. The higher-caste gnomes live in an advanced society inside a huge vault, where they previously dedicated themselves to their ruler King Mechagon. Under King Mechagon's society, the more robot parts one has, the higher one's social standing is. described ones on the right-hand side as the less mechanical ones that inhabit the Junker Wastes, while the ones on the left as the more mechanical ones that ser
Mechagon Containment Crates are gnomish copters carrying crates. They are located at Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
The Mechagonian Sawblades are a toy that drop from Kill Saw on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Mechagon Marmots are marmots located on central and north-eastern Mechagon Island.
Mechagon Refugees are Mechagon mechagnomes located in Rustbolt in Mechagon Island.
Mecha-Done is a meta-achievement that is earned through questing, Junkyard Tinkering, killing rares and other objectives in Mechagon Island.
Mechanized Scraphounds are mechanical wolves located in an alternate future of Mechagon Island.
Mechanized Coilbearers are gnomebots located on Mechagon Island.
Mechanized Enforcers are gnomebots located on Mechagon Island.
Mechanized Crawlers are mechano-tanks located on Mechagon Island. Some are found in Bondo's Yard being worked on by Repeating Wrenchbots and Pistonhead Recyclers.
Mechagon Projector is located in the Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island. It can be hacked to display the Rustbolt Resistance Banner.
Mechacrawler Legs are found in Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.

Mechanical Giblets drop from the following mobs on Mechagon Island: *Scrapbone Colossus *Scrapbone Flamebelcher *Scrapbone Grinder *Scrapbone Grunter *Scrapbone Oilspewer *Scrapbone Trashtosser *Sourback Rider
Mechanized Supply Key has a chance to drop from the Seaspray murlocs on Mechagon Island.
Mechanical dogs are mechanized versions of regular dogs. They may appear in variety places across Azeroth such as Mechagon Island.
Mechabyte is a mechanical dog located in Prospectus Bay on Mechagon Island. Next to him is a Flamingo.

Mecha-Golems are pounder robots created by Dataguru Gryzix. Several have been stolen by the sethrak at Scalefang Outpost in Vol'dun, but since the sethrak neglected to steal the keys to the mechs, Enslaved Helper-Bots guarded by Scalefang Warguards can be seen futilely trying to get them operational while Scalefang Stormbringers try to empower them with lightning. Gryzix asks engineering adventurers to free the golems from the outpost. One golem subsequently accompanies the adventurer as they retrieve Gryzix's toolbox and helps them battle Chief Expedition Officer McCormick after Gryzix is killed by the Venture Co..
Mecha-Mon is a malfunctioning gnomebot that thinks it is a troll and started gathering followers on Mechagon Island. It was encountered by Alliance and Horde champions.
Mechagonian Nullifier is a gnomebot located in the Junkwatt Depot on Mechagon Island.
Mechanical Guardhounds are mechanical wolves located on Island Expeditions.
Mechanized Supply Chests are chests located on Mechagon Island. They are opened with Mechanized Supply Key.
Mecha-Safari is a pet battle achievement earned by catching every battle pet on Mechagon Island.
Meat Marauder is a feat of strength achievement earned by being an Owner of the Meat Wagon (item) mount from the Warcraft III: Reforged promotion.
Mechanized Crawlers are mechano-tanks encountered by Alliance and Horde champions on Mechagon Island.
Mechagon Suspension Chambers are located on Mechagon Island.
Measured Contemplation is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of Measured Contemplation.
Mawsworn Val'kyr are Val'kyr flying all around Oribos during Report to Oribos. Many are engaged in combat with winged covenant troops such as Stoneborn Guardians and Kyrian Defenders.
__NOTOC__ Meandering Story is a flying tome located in Ardenweald. It wanders the central area between Glitterfall Basin, Tirna Vaal, Hibernal Hollow, and Heart of the Forest.
__NOTOC__ Maybe Meat is a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking.
Maximum Power! is a reputation achievement earned by reaching Maximum reputation with the Cobalt Assembly.

Meilosh is a furbolg tradeskill vendor (though accepts only Runecloth and Mooncloth from players Friendly or above), tailoring trainer, and Cloth Quartermaster, located in the main chamber of Timbermaw Hold in Felwood. He is a member of the Timbermaw tribe, and some of the items he sells require a good reputation with the Timbermaw.
Melnan Darkstone is a dwarf quest giver who can be found patrolling around the Commons of Ironforge during the Darkmoon Faire.

Melisara is a banshee located in Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Prior to the Cataclysm, she directed Forsaken agents to take back the Crown of Will from Mug'thol the ogre, a former subordinate of the Forsaken who gained free will after taking the Crown for himself, and also enlisted adventurers to eradicate the Stormpike presence in Hillsbrad. Following the Cataclysm and the Forsaken's renewed conquest of Lordaeron, she aided the adventurers and High Warlord Cromush in defending Hillsbrad against the Stormpike Guard. She and several others witnessed the arrival of Orkus and Kasha. She communicated telepathically with the adventurers as they were breaking the fingers of Hillsbrad, de

Melgromm Highmountain is an elite tauren shaman part of the Horde. He spawned during the Dark Portal Opens event, specifically when the Dark Portal was starting to be overrun by demons. He wields a two-handed totem as a weapon which is rare. Although he is definitely associated with the Horde, he is friendly to everyone.

Mekeda is a Broken quest giver located at the Refugee Caravan in Terokkar Forest. He is a Broken belonging to the Lower City faction. His friend, Akuno is held hostage in the Shadow Tomb to the west. Tired of waiting on aid for the caravan to come from Shattrath, he takes the initiative of thinning the Cabal's members. He is disgusted with how the cult has treated Auchindoun and its sacred relics.
Mekthorg the Wild is a fel orc rare mob found in traveling around in Hellfire Peninsula. He can perform a large knockback whirlwind-like ability.
Medallion of the Alliance is a PvP reward, and can be purchased from the following vendors for : * in Champions' Hall, Stormwind City * in Dalaran * in Gadgetzan, Tanaris

Some hunters focus their talents on melee weapons. These brave individuals take up the spear or axe and stalk dangerous creatures until they are close enough to pounce. They revel in the danger of their actions, feeling an unparalleled rush when they can bring a deadly creature down in equal combat - especially if they use their bare hands. Other hunters will prefer to use twin daggers, augmented by the elemental power of their traps, although their style of dagger fighting is much more loose and improvisatory than that of the Rogue. The melee hunter's animal companion assists its master by distracting the enemy and flanking it.
Megalith is a mountain giant found at Frostblade Peak in the Howling Fjord.
Medallion of Heroism is a quest reward from The Battle For The Undercity.

__NOTOC__ Melt is a ghoul minion of Munch. Originally a death knight initiate at Acherus, Melt apparently did not prove particularly adept; he was killed, transformed into a ghoul, destroyed by Scarlet Peasants, then reanimated once more and taken as a minion by Munch. He is reportedly an excellent cook. Together, Munch and Melt help players defeat Salranax the Flesh Render during The Air Stands Still.

Mei is a pandaren from the Wandering Isle. One of the elders of the island, she is the grandmother of Shisai and Li Li and the mother of Chon Po's deceased wife Xiu Li. She gave gold to Li Li for her birthdays. According to Li Li, Mei drinks medicine to help her sleep at night. She was present when Wanyo returned. She was unsure about a pearl that the fisherman brought. After Li Li left again, Mei tried to soothe Chon Po by reminding him of Xiu Li and telling him the last words Strongbo said to Li Li and Chen before he died. She explained that the death of the body was better than the death of the spirit, and reminded him that she had already lost her own daughter. Though her fears about Xiu
Mei Lin is a pandaren riding trainer found near the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.
Mei Laoshi is a pandaren swimming instructor found at an island hut off the northern coast of Kun-Lai Summit. She is watching Eva Dendra, who is swimming in the waters nearby.
Melody is a raven located in Stormwind City. It follows Elizabeth Birdsong.

Mellok, Son of Torok is the son of Torok Bloodtotem, chieftain of the Bloodtotem tribe of Highmountain tauren. He is first seen at Thunder Totem, but later joins his father and the rest of his tribe in swearing allegiance to the Burning Legion and transforming into Feltotem, and is found as a killable vignette at Torok's Bluff. The Wardens want the Illidari to deal with him.
__NOTOC__ Melitier Vahlouran is a nightborne located in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. She resolved to go to Hillsbrad Foothills and left Orgrimmar via main gate.
Medicine men are healers who specialize in potions, bandages and shaman magic.
The Mechanobot Ignition can bought from Cork Stuttguard in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island for .
Mechanocat and Rider can be bought from Cork Stuttguard in Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island for .

__NOTOC__ The Mechanocat Laser Pointer teaches you how to summon the X-995 Mechanocat. Marvelous Martini at Bondo's Yard on Mechagon Island can customize the colors of this mechanocat mount. Collecting all the paint colors collection achievement Available in Eight Colors.

in Operation: Mechagon.]] The Mechoriginator is a device in Mechagon City that King Mechagon plans to use to purge the Curse of Flesh from Azeroth and mechanize the entire world. The device was used on Kervo Cogpipe as a form of "reward" for informing King Mechagon about Prince Erazmin's betrayal. Erazmin has stated that the device could theoretically work as his father plans, and convert races changed by the Curse of Flesh to what they had been originally; gnomes would become mechagnomes, dwarves would become earthen, and so on. However, any race that is not descended from the titan-forged (for example goblins, trolls, elves, or alien races) would be eradicated completely. Whether his fathe
Mechaspider Legs are contained in Mechacrawler Legs in Scrapbone Den on Mechagon Island.
Mecharantula is a mechanical spider located on Mechagon Island.

Mekkatorque's Escape Pod is an escape pod containing Gelbin Mekkatorque after the Battle of Dazar'alor located in Boralus and later on Mechagon Island. After releasing Gelbin in Rustbolt, the pod was taken away by a Claw of Life.

Menethil Bay is a portion of the Great Sea off the west coast of the Wetlands in central Eastern Kingdoms. It is within Baradin Bay, its inlet between Menethil Harbor and the northern cliffs of Dun Morogh. Prior to the Cataclysm, it was crawling with crocolisks of various ages and sizes, often hunted for their fine leather. The subsequent flooding of the nearby harbor filled the bay with sharks and crabs. The Flying Osprey wreckage is located in the bay's entrance. Directly east of the bay is Black Channel Marsh.
The Mendicant's Slippers are cloth slippers that provide nice bonuses to casters together with a good mana regeneration.

Menethil Keep is the fort that dominates the Alliance port town of Menethil Harbor. It is led by Captain Stoutfist, the commander of the Menethil militia. Besides several guards, it also normally holds a few additional quest givers and a vendor. During the flooding of Menethil Harbor during the Shattering, the keep and some of the adjacent area was saved due to being on slightly higher ground. Sandbags are used to hold off the tide in more vulnerable areas, giving local merchants a safe and dry place to sell their goods. With the destruction of Menethil's horse stables, the horses are being temporarily kept on the western side of the keep. Shortly after the flooding, Menethil was assaulted b
Mendorn is a draenei Aldor banker located at the northwestern Terrace of Light bank in Shattrath City.

The Menagerie in Karazhan lies beyond the Broken Stair and leads directly into the Guardian's Library. This is the location of The Curator, and several other arcane guardians populate the area as well. It appears to be some sort of Museum-esque display hall with several statues. There are mostly raven statues, with one large work reminiscent of a titan-made golem at the entrance. Though the room looks normal (if not wrecked) at first glance, you will quickly notice that the wreckage is not what it seems, often floating in place as though frozen in time as it fell apart. The Menagerie was used by the Dark Riders to house magical artifacts they obtained under the service of Sargeras.
Meng Chi the Fist is a pandaren drink vendor found passed out on a bed in the Shrine of Seven Stars. He appears in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.
Mending Necklace of the Golden Lotus is a quest reward from The Final Power.

Mender Elum is a draenei ghost that appears at the Congregation of Souls in Auchindoun while fighting Teron'gor. He spent a lifetime healing others, but Teron'gor corrupts his spirit to gain powers of Affliction.

Memories of Fel, Frost and Fire is the Feat of Strength achievement earned for completing each memory during WoW's 15th Anniversary. The quest, How Things "Really" Happened..., requires the completion of an epic trial of a 25-player raid that pits players against some of the most iconic bosses throughout World of Warcraft. There are three wings of the epic trial with three bosses each: *The Burning Crusade wing **Kael'thas Sunstrider **Lady Vashj **Archimonde *Wrath of the Lich King wing **Heigan the Unclean **Anub'arak **The Lich King *Cataclysm wing **Cho'gall **Nefarian **Ragnaros

The Memories of Azeroth are a set of miniature raid wings that celebrate raids from expansions past. They are accessed by talking to Chromie in the Caverns of Time during the 15th Anniversary event. Each wing contains three encounters that must be defeated in a row; lose a fight and it's back to the start. The encounters consist of brief moments against iconic adversaries defeated by adventurers over the years. Besting a wing will grant access to a Gift of the Bronze Dragonflight, which contains timewarped loot based on the loot tables of the bosses in the wing. Completing all three wings will grant Memories of Fel, Frost and Fire.
Memory of the Wall drops from the Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria.
Memory of the Disciplinary Command drops from Mistcaller in the Mists of Tirna Scithe. It unlocks the runecarving power, Disciplinary Command.
Memory of Gorefiend's Domination drops from the Hungering Destroyer in Castle Nathria.

Memories of Sunless Skies is a quest reward from The Primus Returns, the end of the fourth chapter of the Chains of Domination campaign added in patch 9.1.0, which requires Renown (Shadowlands) 44 to start. Once used, flight will be enabled in the four level-up zones of Shadowlands for all players on the account. Only the first player on an account will receive this as a reward, as alts will just receive the Emblem of Renown.
Memory of a Prism of Shadow and Fire drops from Mueh'zala in De Other Side. It unlocks the runecarving power, Shadowflame Prism.
Memory of Talbadar drops from the Upper Reaches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned on layer 3+. It unlocks the runecarving power, Talbadar's Stratagem.
Memory of Devastating Chains are sold by Purveyor Zo'kuul in Oribos for .
Melted Vials were Imbued Vials destroyed in the Cataclysm. All alchemy recipes now use Crystal Vials instead.
Mephistroth is a horrifically powerful nathrezim, second only to Tichondrius and Anetheron. Mephistroth remained in the Twisting Nether during the Third War.
Mennet Carkad is a Forsaken located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity. He participated in the Battle for Darkshore, Where he seems to talk to Aleric Hawkins.

Meridith the Mermaiden was a level 60 naga quest giver in Tanaris. She was encountered during the Scepter of the Shifting Sands quest chain and could be found off the eastern part of Land's End Beach. She has been in love with Narain Soothfancy ever since he crashed (with a Gnomish flying machine, as expected) onto her shore, though it is implied that he kindly accepted her help and ran away as soon as he could (and realized that she was into him).
Mental Strength is a tier 5 discipline talent that increases your total intellect. The enlargement of intellect also increases other mana-based talents and spells.
Mercutio is Marshal Reginald Windsor's steed. Upon Windsor's entrance to Stormwind City, he sends the horse running off into Elwynn Forest with a "Yawww!".
